name: Norfolk Island Data Services
summary: Norfolk Island's ISP (ni.net.nf online by Dec 1998); fate unverified (NIDS PTY LIMITED (Norfolk Island entity), ABN 53 843 802 983).

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of ni.net Dec 1996. CAUTION: ni.net 1996-98 captures show 'Network Intensive' (Irvine CA, US ISP) — different company; do not use ni.net captures as evidence.
Verified still operating as an ISP in Sep 2026 (live site retailing internet services); earlier death record removed.

refs.label: NIDS's real retail site is live today (checked 29 Sep 2026); it also runs the .nf ccTLD registry (nic.nf)
